body.acceptance_criteria: SPEC_V2 §12 T3: PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline change requires a change request. The manifest acceptance/programme/T3.toml is the gate, not prose.
body.assignment: The T3 slice (issue #74) under the programme's PM governance: the PM request-to-plan path, the dual-controlled gates, the change-request path and closure against the frozen baseline.
body.responsibilities: The PM job requests and plans; the approver job decides every gate and is never its requester; the programme manager owns delivery; the architect owns the baseline's architecture content; the programme board reviews the tranche.
body.scope: pm.plan and projects.baseline; the charter, baseline and change gates; the change-request path with its impact block; projects.close_request and projects.close. Not in scope: project creation and the board surfaces (S05).
